body.name: Exact deterministic linear-band width frontier
body.construction: For \(s\in\{\mathrm{nested},\mathrm{deep}\}\), \(W_s=\inf_{w\in\mathcal F_s,\,\ell\in[0,\infty)^M}\max_{e\in\mathcal E}\ell_e\) subject to \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,K,p}}P\{ |\widehat\tau_e(w)-\tau_e|\le\ell_e\text{ for every }e\in\mathcal E\}\ge1-\alpha\), where \(w\) and \(\ell\) are functions only of the fixed design and model inputs.
